plain_english: Clouds thundering make travelers long; sorrow grows in those, endless.
sanskrit_cite: utkaṇṭhayanti pathikāṇ jaladāḥ svanantaḥ śoko vivardhati ca tadvinatāsv anantaḥ

plain_english: They honor the love-festival with beloveds; cloud-arrival, dear friend, they bring.
sanskrit_cite: ratyutsavaṃ priyatamaiḥ saha mānayanti meghāgamaṃ priyasakhi śvasamānayanti

plain_english: May I be conquered by which poet, by yamakas, other; to him I pour water in ghaṭakarpara.
sanskrit_cite: jīyeya yena kavinā yamakaiḥ pareṇa tasmai vaheyam udakaṃ ghaṭakarpareṇa
